item.title: A Hashar in Our Mahalla
item.summary: At a neighbourhood meeting, a volunteer explains the plan for Saturday's community clean-up and tree planting.
item.transcript_text: Good evening, neighbours, and thank you for coming to this meeting. As you know, spring is here, and our mahalla is organising a hashar this Saturday. For anyone who is new to the area, a hashar is when neighbours work together to help the community. This time we're planning to clean the park next to the school and plant fifty young trees. We'll meet at the park gate at eight in the morning, before it gets too hot. Please wear old clothes and bring gloves if you have them. The mahalla will provide spades, rubbish bags and drinking water. We especially need a few people with cars to collect the trees from the garden centre on Friday evening. If you can help with that, please speak to me after the meeting. Children are very welcome, but they should stay with an adult. When we've finished, at about one o'clock, there will be lunch for everyone in the school yard. I hope to see as many of you there as possible.
